Response List Assessments Api Jobs  Job Id  Assessments Get

Response My Interviews Api Recruiter Interviews Get

get.description: The exact wording a candidate is shown before agreeing to use camera and microphone.

schema.title: Response My Invitations Api Candidate Interviews Get

put.description: Record yes or no for live camera/microphone. Saying no never affects the application.

post.description: A one-use, 60-second ticket to open the signalling connection. Consent is checked here.

advisory.default: Advisory only. A human makes every hiring decision.

AttemptOut.title: AttemptOut
AttemptOut.description: Candidate view of an attempt. Never includes scores, correct answers or rubrics.

advisory.title: Advisory
advisory.default: Assessment results are one input. A person makes every hiring decision.

CandidateApplicationOut.title: CandidateApplicationOut
CandidateApplicationOut.description: Candidate-facing view: stage only. Never includes scores, notes or decision reasons.

CandidateInterviewOut.title: CandidateInterviewOut
CandidateInterviewOut.description: What a candidate sees. Never includes the recruiter's internal notes.

CandidateQuestionOut.title: CandidateQuestionOut
CandidateQuestionOut.description: What a candidate sees: never the correct option and never the rubric.

note.title: Note
note.default: Draft only. HireSense never sends email. A person reviews it and sends it.

OpeningOut.title: OpeningOut
OpeningOut.description: What a candidate sees: no recruiter details, no internal fields.
